Metadata.title: SoroSave - Decentralized Group Savings
Metadata.description: A decentralized rotating savings protocol built on Soroban. Create or join savings groups, contribute each cycle, and receive the pot when it is your turn.

Home.heroDescription: SoroSave brings the traditional rotating savings model (ajo, susu, chit fund) to the Stellar blockchain. Trustless, transparent, and accessible.

create.title: Create a Group
create.description: Set contribution amount, cycle length, and max members. You become the admin.

join.title: Members Join
join.description: Share the group link. Members join until the group is full or the admin starts it.

contribute.title: Contribute Each Cycle
contribute.description: Every member contributes the fixed amount each round. Smart contract enforces rules.

payout.title: Receive the Pot
payout.description: Each round, one member receives the full pot. Continues until everyone has received.

trustless.title: Trustless
trustless.description: Smart contracts enforce contributions and payouts. No middleman needed.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.description: All transactions are on-chain. Every member can verify the group state.

lowCost.title: Low Cost
lowCost.description: Built on Soroban (Stellar). Transaction fees are a fraction of a cent.

Home.footerDescription: Open-source decentralized group savings protocol on Soroban.
